name: Button
description: A clear action with primary, secondary, quiet, ghost, or destructive emphasis.
behavior: Use one primary action per decision. Cancel always has a subtle border and surface.

name: IconButton
description: A compact, named action for familiar symbols.
behavior: The accessible label describes the action. Touch targets expand to 44px.

name: TextLink
description: An underlined destination within prose or supporting navigation.
behavior: Use a link for navigation and a button for an action. Pink text uses the deeper accessible tone.

name: PillButton
description: A labeled toggle for a small filter or preference.
behavior: Uses aria-pressed. The check and border make selection visible without relying on color.

name: Field
description: A complete field: persistent label, control, hint, and error.
behavior: Label and helper IDs are connected to the control. Errors keep the original input.

name: Input
description: A single-line input with a quiet, contained focus treatment.
behavior: Focus changes the existing 1px border without an outer halo or offset outline.

name: Textarea
description: A resizable multi-line field for longer content.
behavior: Preserve newlines and let the field grow vertically. Code variant uses IBM Plex Mono and a 220px minimum; short size uses 96px. Use a visible label.

name: Select
description: A polished single-choice control for short form lists.
behavior: Uses the shared custom dropdown. Selection changes only after the user commits an option.

name: Dropdown
description: The shared dropdown surface, trigger, and keyboard interaction.
behavior: Options support descriptions, counts, and disabled states. The popup chooses available viewport space.

name: Picker
description: A dropdown for filters, with optional counts.
behavior: Use counts to explain a filter, and offer an explicit All option to reset it.

name: ComboboxPicker
description: A searchable choice list for larger collections.
behavior: Search is local and case-insensitive. Empty results explain how to recover.

name: Checkbox
description: An independent on/off choice that can accompany helper text.
behavior: Uses a native checkbox. Clicking the label changes the value; Space toggles it.

name: Radio
description: One choice within a mutually exclusive named group.
behavior: Use a fieldset and legend for a related group. Native arrow-key behavior stays intact.

name: Switch
description: An immediate binary setting, with a label and optional hint.
behavior: The switch applies directly. Use a checkbox for a selection that waits for form submission.

name: SwitchRow
description: A setting name and explanation aligned with its switch.
behavior: Keep the whole row large enough to click, without hiding the setting name.

name: SearchField
description: A reusable search input with a visible clear action.
behavior: Clearing the field resets the results. It does not discard unrelated filters.

name: TagInput
description: Editable tags with keyboard entry and removal.
behavior: Enter or comma adds a trimmed, unique tag. Backspace on an empty input removes the last tag.

name: FileUpload
description: A document card with browse, drag-and-drop, validation, and file details.
behavior: Accepts one PDF, Markdown, or text file up to 10 MB by default. This local component does not transmit files.

name: Dropzone
description: The shared file-upload pattern, replacing local dashed boxes.
behavior: This is the FileUpload implementation under the migration alias Dropzone.

name: AppSwitcher
description: A stable, labeled entry to Workspace, Agents Studio, and Knowledge.
behavior: Changing apps preserves the surrounding navigation grammar.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: A compact path showing the current location and its parents.
behavior: Only the final item is current. Parent items are actionable; separators are decorative.

name: TabStrip
description: Keyboard-navigable tabs for sections of one object.
behavior: Left/Right, Home, and End move between tabs. Selection uses aria-selected and a clear underline.

name: SegmentedControl
description: A compact switch between related views of the same content.
behavior: Uses a group of pressed buttons, not mixed tab semantics. Keep labels brief and meaningful.

name: NavTree
description: Expandable document groups with a clear current page.
behavior: Uses native disclosure navigation. Each document remains a normal keyboard-reachable button.

name: AccountMenu
description: A predictable menu for profile, workspace, and support actions.
behavior: Keep account actions separate from project actions. The trigger includes a person’s name.

name: Toc
description: A reading rail with direct links to document headings.
behavior: Links move to actual anchors. Hide the rail only when the article retains its headings.

name: Pill
description: A small labeled state with a semantic color and dot.
behavior: Use ok, warn, bad, info, or quiet. A color never replaces the written state.

name: StatusPill
description: The project-state vocabulary on the shared Pill.
behavior: Planning, In progress, In review, and Completed map to one shared set of tones.

name: Chip
description: A compact category or removable tag.
behavior: Removable tags have a named remove button. Passive tags never look like interactive buttons.

name: Avatar
description: An initials marker supporting an identifiable person.
behavior: Use a visible name nearby. The avatar alone should not be the only identification.

name: DeptTile
description: A department label using the dedicated pink-harmonized color scale.
behavior: Department colors describe ownership. They never indicate success, warning, or failure.

name: Timestamp
description: A human-readable date with a machine-readable datetime value.
behavior: The title contains the complete localized date. Timezone context belongs in the surrounding screen.

name: Kbd
description: A small keycap for a real, supported keyboard shortcut.
behavior: Only show shortcuts that actually work. Keep the keycap visually secondary.

name: LegendDot
description: A labeled chart category with its matching color.
behavior: Place the label beside the color. Never ask users to distinguish unlabeled colors.

name: Stat
description: A metric with its label and useful context.
behavior: Use tabular numerals. A number needs a unit or explanation when its meaning is not obvious.

name: StatRow
description: A responsive row of related metrics separated by quiet rules.
behavior: Keep related metrics on one continuous surface, not a grid of identical floating cards.

name: Facts
description: Aligned labels and values for object properties.
behavior: Use a semantic definition list. Long values wrap instead of widening the page.

name: Meter
description: A measurable completion value with text and progress semantics.
behavior: Expose the value and its range to assistive technology. Unknown progress uses a loading state instead.

name: DataTable
description: A complete collection table with search, filtering, sorting, selection, and pagination.
behavior: Selection, row actions, and sorting are explicit controls. The scroll container is keyboard accessible.

name: FilterRow
description: A consistent search and status-filter arrangement with a reset.
behavior: The clear action only appears when a filter is applied. Mobile controls wrap rather than shrink.

name: SortHead
description: A column heading button with a visible and announced sort direction.
behavior: Use aria-sort on the enclosing column header and a button inside it.

name: AppHeader
description: A responsive application header with context, search and actions.
behavior: Context shrinks before actions. Search becomes an icon button on phone; use Breadcrumbs truncate to keep long record titles on one line.

name: ScrollArea
description: Native scrolling with a short, transparent pink indicator flush to the container edge.
behavior: The 2px rectangular thumb is at most 28px long. Wheel, touch, keyboard, and thumb dragging work together. No indicator appears when content fits.

name: Panel
description: A titled group of related content with an optional section action.
behavior: Use a surface when the content has a distinct purpose, not around every individual item.

name: Card
description: The same surface contract as Panel, with optional content.
behavior: Shares Panel geometry and spacing instead of introducing a second card family.

name: CollectionCard
description: A selectable collection preview with a title, description, and metadata.
behavior: The full card is one action. Do not nest interactive buttons inside it.

name: LinkTile
description: A compact shortcut with an icon, name, and explanation.
behavior: Use for a destination or tool. Keep the title specific enough to predict what opens.

name: Rows
description: A continuous container for related row items.
behavior: Use dividers to separate items without giving every row its own card.

name: Row
description: A labeled content row with supporting text and optional action.
behavior: Passive rows are not buttons. Actionable rows show a chevron and have one clear target.

name: SectionHead
description: A section title, optional description, and one related action.
behavior: Keep the action aligned with its section rather than placing every action in the page header.

name: SidebarShell
description: Application shell with optional department spaces rail, foldable tools and fixed account controls.
behavior: Import navigation/styles.css. Spaces are app-controlled; arrow keys move focus and Cmd/Ctrl+backslash folds. The real ARLAB wordmark sits in a square brand area; fold controls stay in fixed bottom footers. Phone space/tool pickers use native dialogs. Existing single/context layouts remain available.

name: PageBar
description: The page title and its primary action in a shared layout.
behavior: The page should explain where the user is before presenting controls.

name: PageGrid
description: The shared main-content and context-rail composition.
behavior: The second column moves below the first when its minimum width is unavailable.

name: CardGrid
description: A responsive grid of collection cards.
behavior: Cards use a consistent minimum width, never a screen-specific auto-fill rule.

name: Stack
description: A vertical layout using a deliberate spacing value.
behavior: Choose gaps from the 4px spacing scale. Use Stack instead of repeated margin overrides.

name: DetailHeader
description: An object title, state, explanation, and supporting facts.
behavior: Use the same order in project, agent, workflow, and document detail pages.

name: Inspector
description: A searchable list and its selected detail in one reusable component.
behavior: The current selection remains visible. On narrow screens the list moves above the detail.

name: Gate
description: The shared access screen with one clear next action.
behavior: The demonstration never sends authentication requests. Production sign-in must state the workspace and provider.

name: Loader
description: A small geometric loader with a fine traveling stroke.
behavior: Announces loading once. Uses no fabricated percentage. Reduced-motion preferences stop the animation.

name: PageLoading
description: A full-page loading state with clear context and a quiet animated loader.
behavior: Use while initial data is unavailable. Replace with the loaded view or a persistent error. Cancel is optional and must abort the real operation.

name: Notice
description: A contained message with an icon, explanation, and semantic tone.
behavior: Explain what happened and what to do next. Persistent messages belong inline, not in temporary toasts.

name: Toast
description: A short confirmation announced without moving keyboard focus.
behavior: Use for successful actions. Critical failures stay inline until they are resolved.

name: Skeleton
description: Static placeholder rows matching the incoming content structure.
behavior: Reserves space without a spinner. Announce loading once, not on every placeholder.

name: LoadingBar
description: A determinate progress indicator with a visible value.
behavior: A real percentage is required. Do not invent progress when the amount of work is unknown.

name: Refreshing
description: A subtle busy treatment over the existing, readable content.
behavior: Keep previous data visible while refreshing. Use aria-busy and one status announcement.

name: StateView
description: A unified empty, error, or loading state with a useful next action.
behavior: Failed loads retain the user’s filters. Empty states invite a specific first action.

name: Tooltip
description: A brief explanation available on hover and keyboard focus.
behavior: Never place essential instructions only in a tooltip. Use aria-describedby.

name: Popover
description: An anchored top-layer surface for a small contextual task.
behavior: Escape and outside clicks close it. The surface stays within the viewport.

name: DropdownMenu
description: A keyboard-navigable action menu with optional icons and shortcuts.
behavior: Arrow keys move through enabled items. Escape returns to the trigger.

name: Dialog
description: A modal decision or focused form using the native dialog layer.
behavior: Focus stays inside. Escape closes; the opening control regains focus.

name: Sheet
description: A side panel for editing without losing the parent context.
behavior: Shares Dialog focus behavior. It becomes full width on a phone.

name: ConfirmDialog
description: An explicit confirmation for a consequential operation.
behavior: Initial focus starts on the safe Cancel action. Name the action instead of saying Yes.

name: ConfirmStrip
description: A contained, in-place confirmation with two clear actions.
behavior: Use only when the action can be understood in the surrounding context.

name: Disclosure
description: The bordered information card with a clear header and expandable body.
behavior: Native details/summary handles Enter and Space. Icon, title, and chevron share one target.

name: SaveBar
description: A persistent editing summary with save and discard actions.
behavior: Save is unavailable when nothing changed. A failed save should preserve the dirty state and user input.

name: FieldRow
description: A setting description aligned with its control.
behavior: The label column has a consistent measure. On mobile the control stacks below the label.

name: SheetSection
description: A reusable section within a sheet or detail panel.
behavior: Group a few related fields under a specific title. Avoid repeating a border around every field.

name: CopyBlock
description: A readable code or value block with a copy action.
behavior: The control confirms a successful clipboard write. The text remains selectable when clipboard permission is unavailable.

name: ReadableDoc
description: A readable article with consistent headings and paragraph rhythm.
behavior: Keep prose within 64 to 72 characters and use 1.75 line height.

name: Markdown
description: An escaped renderer for headings, paragraphs, lists, and fenced code.
behavior: This implementation supports a documented Markdown subset and never renders raw HTML.

name: Timeline
description: A sequence of updates with content and time labels.
behavior: The order is meaningful. Do not rely on the connecting line to communicate chronology.

name: Steps
description: A visible sequence with current and completed states.
behavior: Current step uses aria-current. Completion has a check icon and text label.

name: ColumnChart
description: A labeled comparison of values with a data-table alternative.
behavior: Use a zero baseline. Values and category labels are visible; color is supplementary.

name: Sparkline
description: A small trend line with an accessible data summary.
behavior: Use it to support a metric, not as the only way to understand the numbers.

name: StackedBar
description: A part-to-whole comparison with a labeled legend and data table.
behavior: Categories use the dedicated chart palette. Totals and category values remain available as text.

name: BarList
description: A ranked or ordered set of values with horizontal bars.
behavior: Labels and values align consistently. The bar width is proportional to the maximum value.

name: Calendar
description: An application calendar with real dates, events and selectable periods.
behavior: Controlled month or rolling periods, including exactly five weeks. Month view expands to include every date. Arrow, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown preserve keyboard focus. Events come only from the application.

name: DayTimeline
description: A time-based view of a day with selectable events.
behavior: Display the timezone. Event details remain available through normal buttons.

name: KanbanBoard
description: A controlled board with independent column scrolling, collapse and phone column navigation.
behavior: The host owns cards and persistence. Move by pointer/touch handle, keyboard pickup/arrows/drop or Move to menu. Omit onMove for read-only. Destination index excludes the moved card. Phone supports tabs and swipe; loading, error, empty and limited columns have explicit states.

name: ProjectStatusSheet
description: The shared project-status editor for Workspace and Knowledge.
behavior: A single status vocabulary and shared sheet replace the duplicated project-status implementations.

name: CollectionWorkspace
description: A full collection that becomes a compact navigator beside the selected record.
behavior: split keeps list and detail side by side; focus gives the record all the width; stacked places a bounded list above detail. Phone shows the selected record with application-owned Back navigation.

name: RecordNavigator
description: A compact searchable record list with real links and quiet selection.
behavior: Names truncate with full-title tooltips; arrow/Home/End keys move focus, Enter opens and modifier-click retains browser behavior. Shared ScrollArea owns the list.

name: RecordSection
description: A borderless section for readable details and focused forms.
behavior: Plain sections avoid nested card surfaces; divided adds a quiet bottom separator. Heading and actions wrap in narrow record panes.

name: ActionGroup
description: A compact wrapping group of related controls.
behavior: Optional label names the group. start/end alignment and token spacing remain shared.

name: InfiniteTable
description: A virtualized sortable table that continues loading as you scroll.
behavior: Local mode sorts the full filtered array before loading windows. Remote mode delegates sorting and pagination to the host. One count pill and search share the fixed header; footerActions remain outside the scroll surface. fill consumes a bounded parent. Fixed row geometry bounds rendered DOM; headers stay fixed. Requests support cancellation, errors and explicit retry.

name: FacetList
description: A vertical filter group with baseline counts and soft selection.
behavior: 13px labels use 32px rows or compact 28px rows. Radio and checkbox semantics support arrow navigation. Phone filters open a shared side panel. Long names keep a tooltip.

name: RankList
description: A selectable ranked list with muted 4px share bars and right-aligned values.
behavior: Rows announce name, metadata, value and rank. Roving keyboard selection and shared scrolling support longer lists. Marks are decorative; numeric values determine bar geometry.

name: StatNote
description: A neutral metric with a separate semantic status and supporting context.
behavior: The figure always stays neutral. Note is a pill or tone dot; trend direction and good/bad meaning are independent. View accepts a link or callback.

name: StatNoteRow
description: Aligned labels, figures, captions and actions across status metrics.
behavior: Shared grid rows align captions and figures even when another metric has a long note. Responsive columns preserve readable text.

name: CollectionLayout
description: A full-width collection destination with search and optional filters.
behavior: Results own the remaining height. Function children receive filterTrigger for placing phone filters inside the table header. Hidden empty headings and toolbars occupy no space. Filters expand on request; changing filters remains application-owned.

name: RecordCollection
description: A responsive collection with sortable desktop results and readable phone rows.
behavior: Records carry id, title, description, category, status, tone, meta and real href. Modifier-click preserves browser navigation.

name: RecordLayout
description: A focused workspace for one selected record.
behavior: Keeps the record header fixed and the content scrollable without a competing browse rail.

name: RecordHeader
description: A record title, publication state, actions and accessible sections.
behavior: Controlled tabs support arrow/Home/End navigation. Secondary details open in a labelled side sheet with fixed heading and footer, shared scrolling and a clear Done action. Back behavior belongs to the host. showTitle and showBack can hide redundant chrome when the app header already provides record identity and breadcrumb navigation.

name: RecordBody
description: One labelled scrolling surface below a record header.
behavior: Connects the active tab to its panel and delegates scrolling to the shared ScrollArea.

name: DetailSections
description: Content proportions for reading, comparing and editing.
behavior: reading reserves a secondary column; split balances two tasks; stacked gives editors a focused column; editor reserves a settings rail; wide uses the full content width. Columns adapt to their record container.

name: FormGrid
description: Responsive form columns with safe minimum widths.
behavior: One or two columns; shared responsive rules collapse paired fields on narrow screens.

name: FormFieldGroup
description: A field label, control and contextual guidance.
behavior: Link htmlFor to the real control ID. Child state and attributes remain owned by the caller.

name: FilterableTable
description: Reusable full-width table with sortable headers, custom cells and built-in pagination.
behavior: Column arrows toggle ascending and descending order before pagination. Headers and cells accept custom content; sortValue supports formatted values. Use FilterSidebar to filter data.

name: FilterSidebar
description: A reusable right-side filter panel, compact version and collapsed vertical rail.
behavior: Controlled filters support search, single selection and multiple selection. Active counts, reset and results stay visible while filter sections scroll.

name: DatePicker
description: A custom calendar with themed controls.
behavior: Stores YYYY-MM-DD; arrow keys navigate dates, Escape closes, and date limits disable unavailable days.

name: TimePicker
description: Custom hour and minute selection.
behavior: Stores local HH:mm; themed dropdowns support keyboard selection. The application owns timezone conversion.

name: DateRangePicker
description: Related start and end dates.
behavior: An end before the start is marked invalid; existing values are never silently changed.

name: NumberInput
description: A numeric field with discreet stepper controls.
behavior: null is empty. Steppers respect limits; typed out-of-range values show an error.

name: ColorPicker
description: Colour chooser, hex entry and presets.
behavior: Only complete six-digit hex values are emitted; invalid drafts stay editable.

name: MediaGallery
description: Images and videos with replacement and removal.
behavior: Application owns URLs and upload lifecycle; video has native playback controls.

name: MediaUploadField
description: A bordered media field with drag-and-drop and browsing.
behavior: Validates media MIME type and size. Async failures are announced; uploading remains application controlled.

name: PreviewFrame
description: A contained live page preview.
behavior: Defaults to a sandboxed iframe; viewport supports desktop, tablet and mobile.

name: EditorLayout
description: A full-height editing workspace.
behavior: Fixed toolbar and footer; properties stack below the preview on narrow screens.

name: ReorderList
description: Direct dragging with insertion feedback and keyboard move controls.
behavior: Stable IDs retain item identity. Move results are announced; the keyboard never requires dragging.

name: InlineEdit
description: Edit a value in place, then explicitly save or cancel.
behavior: Enter saves, Escape cancels. Pending saves disable controls; rejected saves preserve the draft.

name: CodeDisplay
description: QR or Snapcode image with download and copy link.
behavior: Displays an application-provided code, never generates one. Copy failure leaves a selectable URL.

name: GuidedTour
description: An opt-in tour launched by a help action.
behavior: Highlights visible targets, skips missing ones, supports Escape and arrows, returns focus to its opener.

name: DeadlineCountdown
description: A time remaining or overdue indicator.
behavior: Invalid dates have a fallback. The timer stops on unmount; now can freeze previews and tests.

name: PhaseBar
description: Seven labelled project phases with distinct muted colours.
behavior: Completion and current step use text and aria-current, not colour alone.

name: DailyVerdictStrip
description: Compact daily status history.
behavior: Use row with plain dates for a single quiet line without boxed cards. Cards remain available. Full dates and written verdicts accompany semantic colour.

name: ElementProgress
description: Progress along the bottom edge of its content.
behavior: Undefined is indeterminate; finite percentages clamp to 0–100; idle removes the progress bar.

name: InlineProgress
description: Alias for embedded element progress.
behavior: Uses the same accessible progress contract as ElementProgress.

name: SectionHeader
description: A restrained section heading and trailing action.
behavior: Uses shared 13px semibold typography; optional count is secondary.

name: CollectionGroup
description: A collection with individual, clearly actionable items.
behavior: Each item has its own action. Long names truncate without widening the card.
